CGI CUEC written for its customers: CUEC-02 - customers must enable MFA, phishing-resistant for administrators
The AWS CUEC it mirrors: AWS CUEC 2 - MFA on the root account and restricted root use
CGI's own status as a customer: UNACCEPTED. F-010; no owner assigned; condition C1 open until 15 Dec 2026.

CGI CUEC written for its customers: CUEC-03 - customers must review their users' access at least quarterly
The AWS CUEC it mirrors: AWS CUEC 3 - least-privilege IAM with periodic review
CGI's own status as a customer: NEVER PERFORMED. CGI-POL-003 s4.7.1 mandates a quarterly privileged review; zero have run (OFI-15).

CGI CUEC written for its customers: CUEC-05 - customers must review the tenant audit log and report anomalies
The AWS CUEC it mirrors: AWS CUEC 1 - organisation-wide CloudTrail with log file validation
CGI's own status as a customer: UNVERIFIED. No central security log account, no retention standard, no alert rules (OFI-03).

CGI CUEC written for its customers: CUEC-07 - customers are responsible for classifying the data they upload
The AWS CUEC it mirrors: AWS CUEC 4 - encryption management for customer-controlled data
CGI's own status as a customer: NO STANDARD. CGI-POL-004 says where encryption is required; no algorithms, TLS minimum or key management exist.
